text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was scheduled to train first thing in the afternoon,
but unusually back-to-back meetings ran late.
When I finally headed to the training track—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, I finally get to see you, Big Brother~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, I finally get to see you, Big Sister~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Jeez... I know you've been busy, but...
leaving Curren waiting all by herself is just...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Even Curren gets lonely, you know?
Hmph!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while that day, instead of training,
I spent my time apologizing to Curren Chan...
